Man Stabbed to Death in Delhi's Kashmere Gate Area

A man was fatally stabbed in Delhi's Kashmere Gate area. The incident occurred in a crowded location. According to reports, the assailant attacked the victim after he resisted a robbery attempt on an e-rickshaw. The victim, identified as Prabhat, died from his injuries, and two other passengers were wounded. The accused fled the scene, and police have registered cases of murder and robbery, initiating a search for the suspects.
